Package io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.factories

package io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.factories
  • Class
    Description
    EventProcessorFactory
    Factory for event processor definitions and the runtime adapter that wraps a raw batch function into an EventProcessor.
    EventProcessorFactory.RawBatchFn
    Raw batch callback used by EventProcessorFactory.createEventProcessorBase(java.lang.String, io.kaleido.workflowengine.sdk.factories.EventProcessorFactory.RawBatchFn): receives the per-request context, the typed events, and the request's authRef.
    EventSourceBuilder<CF>
    Fluent builder for configuring an event source with optional lifecycle hooks.
    EventSourceConf<CF>
    Stream identity plus the parsed configuration for an event source stream.
    EventSourceConfigParserFn<CF>
    Custom parser for event source stream config.
    EventSourceDeleteFn
    Cleanup callback invoked when an event source stream is removed.
    EventSourceEvent
    Event returned by an event source poll function.
    EventSourceFactory
    Factory for event sources built from a poll function, with optional lifecycle hooks configured through the returned EventSourceBuilder.
    EventSourceInitialCheckpointFn<CF>
    Builds the initial checkpoint for a new stream from its parsed config.
    EventSourcePollFn<CF>
    Poll function for an event source: given the stream config and the last checkpoint (null on first poll), returns the events read and the new checkpoint.
    EventSourcePollOutput
    Result of an event source poll: the new checkpoint plus the events read since the previous checkpoint.
    HandlerInitFn
    Optional initialization callback for factory-built handlers, invoked once before the WebSocket connection is established.
    TransactionHandlerBuilder
    Fluent builder for configuring a factory-built transaction handler with optional lifecycle hooks.
    TransactionHandlerFactory
    Factory for directed transaction handlers: handlers that route each transaction to an action from the input's action field via the StageDirector pattern.
